about: Acceptance criteria for `mir-bench compare`. Tier 1 = exact work counters, tier 2 = CPU counters, tier 3 = measured times and energy. A metric regresses when its median across launches grows past its tier's limit and, for tiers 2 and 3, the one-sided Mann-Whitney test across launches gives p < alpha. Changing a limit is a reviewed diff like any other.

gpu.reason: GPU time on small frames that wait for each other depends on the GPU's clock state; reported until its noise is measured

cycles.reason: cycles move with clock speed; instructions are the CPU gate

energy.reason: the OS estimates per-process energy; reported until its noise is measured

footprint.reason: one-time driver allocations land in whichever memory benchmark runs first
